title: Unit 7: Traffic
source: Tiếng Anh 7 - Global Success - Sách bài tập, trang 53-59

exercises.instruction: Choose the word in which the underlined part is pronounced differently.
Single-underline the words with the sound /eɪ/ and double-underline the words with the sound /aɪ/ in the dialogue. Then act out the dialogue with a friend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Excuse me. This train is late! I've been here since nine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: I don't think there's a nine-twenty train to Miami.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: But I wrote in my notebook: Miami train – nine-twenty.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Oh, no. The Miami train leaves at eight-twenty.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes. They changed the timetable at the end of July. It's the fourth of August today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Oh, dear! What time does the train go to Miami today?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: So the train isn't late! I'm late!

answer_key.note_pronunciation: Đáp án chi tiết từ Keys chỉ hiển thị lại toàn bộ hội thoại đã gạch chân/gạch đôi, không tách riêng danh sách từng từ theo âm. Cần xem sách để đối chiếu chính xác gạch chân đơn (/eɪ/) và gạch đôi (/aɪ/).

exercises.note: Bài luyện phát âm/đóng vai hội thoại — không phù hợp chấm trắc nghiệm tự động, chỉ hiển thị nội dung tham khảo.

exercises.instruction: Read the following passage and decide whether the statements are true (T) or false (F).
exercises.passage: Who are the best drivers? According to a recent survey, young and inexperienced drivers are the most likely to have an accident. Older drivers are more careful. Young men have the worst accident record of all. They often drive faster cars with bigger engines. One of the most interesting findings in the survey is that passengers can affect the driver. When young male drivers drive their friends, their driving becomes worse. When their wives or girlfriends are in the car; however, their driving improves. But this is not true for women. Their driving is more dangerous when their husbands or boyfriends are in the car. However, if their children are riding in the car, they drive more slowly and safely.

questions.stem: According to the survey, young and inexperienced drivers are the most likely to have an accident.
Generally, older men are likely to drive fast cars with big engines.
Passengers have an effect on the driver.
When men have their wives or girlfriends in the car, they drive worse.
When children are in the car, mothers drive more slowly and safely.

At the underground you can find good maps that tell you the station names and show you (8) ____ to get to them, so that it is easy to find your way.

exercises.instruction: Read the passage and put a suitable word or phrase from the box in each of the gaps.
exercises.passage_template:

It can also reduce the time people go to work and the cost of living. Public transport is especially (4) ____ for people with low income. Public transport also helps us keep our community greener and (5) ____. It can improve our health and reduce healthcare costs. exercises.instruction: Write full sentences, using the words and phrases given.

questions.prompt:
– How / your close friend / go / school /?
– She / cycle /.
questions.suggested_answer:
– How does your close friend go to school?
– She cycles.

questions.prompt: Traffic jams / a problem / big cities / Viet Nam /.
questions.suggested_answer: Traffic jams are a problem in big cities in Viet Nam.

questions.prompt: If you / not careful / fall off / your bicycle /.
questions.suggested_answer: If you are not careful, you may / will fall off your bicycle.

questions.prompt: Before / every meal / should wash / our hands / carefully /.
questions.suggested_answer: Before every meal, we should wash our hands carefully.

questions.prompt: It / about 300 km / Ho Chi Minh City / Phu Quoc Island /.
questions.suggested_answer: It is about 300 km from Ho Chi Minh City to Phu Quoc Island.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite the following sentences so that their meaning stays the same, using the word given for each.

questions.prompt: A train leaves for Da Nang at 5 o'clock every morning. (THERE)
questions.suggested_answer: There is a train leaving for Da Nang at 5 o'clock every morning.

questions.prompt: Is it possible to travel to Sa Pa by air? (CAN)
questions.suggested_answer: Can you / we travel to Sa Pa by air?

questions.prompt: Our teacher is always a careful driver. (DRIVES)
The distance from Ha Noi to Hue City is about 540 km. (IT)
questions.suggested_answer: It is about 540 km from Ha Noi to Hue City.

questions.prompt: Road users should obey traffic rules strictly. (OBEYED)
questions.suggested_answer: Traffic rules should be strictly obeyed (by road users).
